name: pov: you open my gallery
summary: Builds an editable 11.4-second portrait gallery montage as a new Draft from a folder of project clips, cut to the plugin's own soundtrack.

compatibility.selects: Development build only. Released-version compatibility is unverified.

de.name: pov: you open my gallery
de.summary: Erstellt aus einem Ordner mit Projektclips einen bearbeitbaren, 11,4 Sekunden langen Hochformat-Galerie-Zusammenschnitt als neuen Draft, geschnitten auf den mitgelieferten Soundtrack.

en.name: pov: you open my gallery
en.summary: Builds an editable 11.4-second portrait gallery montage as a new Draft from a folder of project clips, cut to the plugin's own soundtrack.

es.name: pov: you open my gallery
es.summary: Crea un montaje de galería vertical editable de 11,4 segundos como nuevo Draft a partir de una carpeta de clips del proyecto, cortado al ritmo de la banda sonora incluida.

fr.name: pov: you open my gallery
fr.summary: Crée un montage galerie vertical modifiable de 11,4 secondes sous forme de nouveau Draft à partir d'un dossier de clips du projet, monté sur la bande-son fournie.

it.name: pov: you open my gallery
it.summary: Crea un montaggio galleria verticale modificabile di 11,4 secondi come nuovo Draft da una cartella di clip del progetto, tagliato sulla colonna sonora inclusa.

ja.name: pov: you open my gallery
ja.summary: プロジェクトのクリップフォルダーから、付属のサウンドトラックに合わせて編集可能な11.4秒の縦型ギャラリーモンタージュを新しいDraftとして作成します。

ko.name: pov: you open my gallery

pt.name: pov: you open my gallery
pt.summary: Cria uma montagem de galeria vertical editável de 11,4 segundos como novo Draft a partir de uma pasta de clipes do projeto, cortada na trilha sonora incluída.

tr.name: pov: you open my gallery
tr.summary: Proje kliplerinden oluşan bir klasörden, birlikte gelen müziğe göre kesilmiş, düzenlenebilir 11,4 saniyelik dikey galeri montajını yeni bir Draft olarak oluşturur.

zh.name: pov: you open my gallery
zh.summary: 从项目片段文件夹生成可编辑的 11.4 秒竖版画廊混剪，作为新的 Draft，并按插件自带的配乐剪辑。

inputs.label: Select 15 videos
inputs.hint: Each plays for about half a second, from its middle.

prepare: Vertical or square clips look best
